question: What radiation, scan range, step size and scan speed were used for powder X-ray diffraction of the sodium chlorate crystals?
expect: Cu K-alpha; 2-100 degrees 2-theta; 0.01 degree steps; 20 degrees/min (Characterization Techniques)

The document "Evaporative Crystallization of Sodium Chlorate Droplets under Controlled Humidity in the Presence of a Static Magnetic Field" states that powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD) was performed on a Rigaku SmartLab diffractometer using Cu Kα radiation in Bragg-Brentano geometry. The scan range was 2−100° 2θ, the step size was 0.01°, and the scan speed was 20°/min.
